evidence_quotes: vanwege geuroverlast handhavend op te treden tegen [belanghebbende] te Helmond, afgewezen.
rationale: The decision concerns an administrative enforcement request regarding odour nuisance (geuroverlast) emitted into outdoor air via a chimney by a manure-processing and transshipment facility (overslag- en mestverwerkingsbedrijf) in Helmond. It deals with air/odour emissions rather than water law, water resources, or water/sanitation services.
